verdict.rationale: Gusto's Embedded Payroll API documents employee tax setup as part of onboarding, covering federal and state tax information (gusto-docs-37, gusto-docs-63), and exposes an employees resource (gusto-docs-43). The official agent-friendly CLI adds `gusto employee` and `gusto compensation` commands, with `--dry-run` previews of create requests and a `--confirm` gate on agent-mode writes (gusto-contest-61-1, gusto-contest-61-2). The pack shows the pieces but never documents an explicit create-employee endpoint or a single end-to-end hire flow. missing for 10: an explicit documented employee-creation endpoint/guide, documented compensation-creation API detail, an end-to-end new-hire onboarding walkthrough via API, and hands-on corroboration of an agent completing the flow.
